decisive_items: Approximately 7 hours after receiving her first dose of vaccination, she developed generalized pruritus and urticaria.
Angioedema of lower lip without airway compromise
response.rationale: Temporal link to vaccination and urticaria with angioedema best fits vaccine-induced urticaria; R1 is less specific, R3 only captures angioedema.

rejected.why: Lacks the causal vaccination context, less specific.
Only describes angioedema, not the primary urticarial presentation.
